title: I ask for help
offscreen: Choose a sentence together for asking for help and practise it at home: 'Miss, I can't do it, can you help me?'

options.label: I ask the teacher
options.outcome: The teacher hooks it in and shows you the trick for tomorrow.

options.label: I ask a classmate
options.outcome: Giulia manages it. Then you show her how to tie a knot.

options.label: I pull hard
options.outcome: It gets even more stuck. In the end you ask for help.

scenes.text: You need the toilet but the teacher is reading.

options.label: I put my hand up
options.outcome: The teacher sees you and nods yes.

options.label: I wait until she finishes
options.outcome: You hold on for a bit, but it's hard. Better to ask.

options.label: I go without saying anything
options.outcome: The teacher gets worried because she can't find you. Better to say.

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, we'll try again.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}. Then tell me what you think.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}, let's do it! Slowly though... all right, slowly.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
